mechanism_hypothesis: The remaining fold instability is not missing ego motion but missing realized treatment-control constraint consequence. A short-horizon paired process aligned with collision/interaction, TTC and off-route semantics should disambiguate valuable interventions from hard-tail/nonbeneficial interventions while keeping the V55 Pareto outcome functional unchanged.
